audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Heimerdinger levels 3, 6 and two items and gave Gwen nothing, contradicting whys[2] through whys[6].
audit.why: His grenade rebuild cadence makes 3 and 4-5 coinflips, and levels 6 and first item are stated outright as Gwen's mist windows. Two items is described as even but rotting in his favour, which is 'Skill', not a win for either.
audit.corrected: Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate instructions to play around the grenade, no cooldown given for it.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank and Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7, against Skip 'n Slash at 13s and Hallowed Mist at 22s. His stun comes back faster than your dash and twice as fast as your mist, so 'bait the grenade' means winning one specific exchange, not opening a long window.
audit.corrected: early, mid, whys[2] and wants.you[0] now carry the 11s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says the mist makes his turrets 'shoot nothing' but never explains the mechanic, and it is the single strongest interaction in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's Hallowed Mist text: Gwen can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Turrets are stationary and cannot enter it, so a turret nest is permanently locked out of targeting a Gwen standing in her own fog - unlike a champion, it can never walk in to fix that. That is a hard, structural answer to his entire zone, and it deserves to be stated as a rule rather than implied.
audit.corrected: mid and spikes[1].text now state that turrets cannot enter the mist and therefore can never re-acquire you.

edits.before: Heimerdinger owns the opening — his turrets wall me off the minions and his Hextech Micro-Rockets plus lightning grenade chip me down long before I have Hallowed Mist to hide in. I have no W untargetability and no real all-in pre-6, so I just eat poke if I walk up to last-hit under his beams. Soak XP at max range, grab the minions I can reach without diving the turret, and do NOT facecheck his grenade — its stun catches me before I can dash and resets the whole zone. This is a survival window, not a trade window.
edits.after: Heimerdinger owns the opening — his turrets wall you off the minions and Hextech Micro-Rockets plus the lightning grenade chip you down long before you have Hallowed Mist to hide in. With no W untargetability and no real all-in pre-6, you just eat poke if you walk up to last-hit under his beams. Soak XP at max range, grab the minions you can reach without diving the turret, and do NOT facecheck the grenade — it is a flat 11s, it stuns you before you can dash, and it resets the whole zone. This is a survival window, not a trade window.

edits.before: By 4-5 I can start contesting if I bait his grenade and dash E onto him while it's down — but he rebuilds the turret wall fast, so don't overstay. Level 6 is where it flips: Needlework gives me a slow to stick to him through his kite, and Hallowed Mist answers his whole kit — his turret beams and rockets can only hit targets, and I'm untargetable to anything standing outside the fog, so I drop W on top of him and snip while the turrets shoot nothing. Force the all-in while his grenade is on cooldown; that's my real opening.
edits.after: By 4-5 you can contest if you bait the 11s grenade and dash E onto him while it is down — but he rebuilds the turret wall fast, so do not overstay. Level 6 is where it flips: Needlework gives you a slow to stick through his kite, and Hallowed Mist answers his whole zone. Turrets are stationary, so they can never enter your fog, which means they can never re-acquire you — drop W on top of him and snip while the nest shoots nothing. Force the all-in in the window right after his grenade; that is your real opening.

edits.before: My Riftmaker/Nashor's spike is the moment to end it — %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus on-hit E lets me dive straight through the turret nest and burst him inside one mist window, and the cooldown refund on E keeps me on him. If I let the game go long, though, his full turret nest plus rocket poke out-zones my engage from range and he kites me out of every fight before I close. This lane is even, but evenness rots in his favor the longer it runs — take the kill the moment my first item completes, then group and deny him a fortified nest on objectives.

notes: Smallest sample in my slice - 119 games at 49.58%, so the win rate is close to noise and I have leaned on the kit rather than the number. Fixes: (1) the content block is first person ('his turrets wall me off', 'I have no W untargetability'); converted early, mid, late and the whys. (2) The chart contradicted the prose at four stages - whys[2] and whys[3] call 3 and 4-5 coinflips, whys[4] and whys[5] give Gwen 6 and first item; corrected to Heimerdinger/Heimerdinger/Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Skill. (3) The page says 'bait his grenade' or 'while his grenade is down' four times without ever giving the number: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank, and Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11s at rank 1 too. An 11-second stun cooldown against your 13s Skip 'n Slash means you get roughly one dash per grenade - that is the entire lane in one sentence, and it was missing. (4) The page never states why Hallowed Mist is so unusually strong here, which is the best fact in the matchup.
